question.problem:
Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{E}[X].$

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{12}, & 0<x<2 \\ \frac{7}{9}, & 2\le x<3\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

 

We compute the expected value of $X$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{0}^{3}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{2}^{3}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}x\cdot \frac{{x}^{2}}{12}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{2}^{3}x\cdot \frac{7}{9}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{{x}^{3}}{12}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{2}^{3}\frac{7x}{9}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{{x}^{4}}{48}|}_{0}^{2}+{\frac{7{x}^{2}}{18}|}_{2}^{3} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}+\frac{35}{18} \\  & =\frac{41}{18}\end{aligned}
$$
